results.title: Business News | AI Volumes May Outweigh Revenue Deflation for IT Sector by FY30: Report
results.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Artificial intelligence (AI) could become a net growth driver for India's IT services industry over the longer term, with AI-led volumes potentially outweighing revenue pressure from automation by FY30, according to a report by CLSA.
